# VatExp

> VatExp (vatexp.com) is a small indigo dye supply business in Portland, Maine, USA. It sells fructose-lime indigo vat kits, natural indigo powder, shibori tools and cotton blanks, and ships within the USA only. "vat" here always means the dyer's vat.

## Goods and prices (USD)
- Indigo vat starter kit: $48
- Natural indigo powder, 50 g: $22
- Shibori tool set: $26
- Cotton blanks, pack of 3: $24
- Vat refill kit: $30

## Pages
- https://vatexp.com/indigo-vat-kits.html : kits and refills, contents and how far they go
- https://vatexp.com/shibori-tools-and-cloth.html : shibori tools, cotton blanks, itajime, arashi and kumo
- https://vatexp.com/how-to-build-an-indigo-vat.html : step-by-step vat guide and the vat calculator
- https://vatexp.com/about-the-dye-room.html : about the dye room
- https://vatexp.com/shipping-rates.html : shipping rates and times
- https://vatexp.com/returns-policy.html : returns and refunds
- https://vatexp.com/order-a-dye-kit.html : order form

## Not offered
No synthetic dyes. No dyeing to order. No workshops or classes. No shipping outside the USA.

Contact: dye@vatexp.com
